hints.title: Sort Events by End Time
hints.text: Sorting events by end time ensures that schedule choices depend only on preceding non-overlapping events.

hints.title: Binary Search Compatible Predecessor
hints.text: For event i starting at start_time, use binary search to locate the last event ending strictly before start_time.

hints.title: Two-Dimensional DP State
hints.text: Let dp[i][j] be maximum value from attending at most j events among first i events: dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[prev][j-1] + value).

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import bisect

class Solution:
    def maxValue(self, events: list[list[int]], k: int) -> int:
        events.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
        n = len(events)
        ends = [e[1] for e in events]
        dp = [[0] * (k + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]

        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            start, end, val = events[i - 1]
            p = bisect.bisect_left(ends, start)
            for j in range(1, k + 1):
                dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[p][j - 1] + val)

        return dp[n][k]
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all combinations of non-overlapping events explores exponential subsets.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting plus 2D DP with binary search evaluates optimal schedules in O(n log n + n * k) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate sorts by end time and finds previous non-overlapping event using binary search.
